phases.name: Spark
phases.goal: Name the problem: the patchwork of grandparents, clubs, swaps and leave

phases.name: Plan
phases.goal: Show the app solving it: gaps glowing red, copy-a-day, share with the other parent

phases.name: Survive
phases.goal: During the break: empathy, humour, quick tips, no hard sell

phases.name: Reflect
phases.goal: Ask what worked; invite reviews; tease the next break
